insights.t: The four methods span ₹ 3.0 Cr, with cost lowest and residual highest
Adjusted sales agree within 1%, which makes the comparable method firm
A sale registered on 12 Sep is newer than the certified value

One comparable is a listing, not a registered deed

mustHave: Written terms of engagement first (VPS 1); conflicts disclosed; working papers kept three years.
Banks need two independent valuations from ₹50 crore; collateral rechecked every three years.
State basis of value, assumptions and uncertainty (Red Book VPS 2 and VPS 6).
Guidance value is a stamp-duty floor, not market value; check Kaveri on the day.
For tax valuation use a valuer on the income-tax register (section 514, Form 170).

mustHave: Before disbursement: financial closure and 75% of land; tenor within 85% of economic life.
DCCO is expected occupancy certificate date; it can be deferred two years at most.
From April 2027, 100% risk weight for residential ADC loans needs 25% borrower contribution.
Commercial area above 10% of total FSI makes the whole loan CRE, not CRE-RH.
Debt cover and loan-to-value minimums are lender policy, not RBI rules; show downside.
